newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Heavy sees plunge in 1996 net.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Heavy sees plunge in 1996 net.

text.p: Daewoo Heavy Industries Ltd, South Korea's leading maker of ships and machinery, expects to see 75 billion won in after-tax net profit for calendar 1996, down from 129.5 billion won in 1995, a company official said on Wednesday.
Daewoo Heavy, an affiliate of the Daewoo Group DWGR.CN, estimated last year's sales at around 5.15 trillion won, sharply up from 3.96 trillion won in 1995, the official said.
He said the company had set a target for this year's sales at 6.1 trillion won.
He declined to give more details, saying final figures would be announced when Daewoo Heavy holds a general shareholders' meeting later this month.
The company also makes light passenger cars with engine capacity of 0.8 litre and trucks.
